x: The mile proved to be an interesting race between Shipley and Len Orton, both second claim members, who finished first and second respectively in 4m.29s. and 4m.33s.
In a tactical half-mile, Robinson and Newell were placed second and third in 1:59.9 and 2:00.2 respectively, and in a similarly run 1500 metres Shipley (second claim) was second in 4:6.2.
Gordon was well backed up by Shipley (3rd), Maclean & Shippen (6th), Forey (8th) and Miller (12th).
